Marco (CS): Heads-up — GreenPillar during kickoff: need per-account token budgets + webhook when usage hits 80%. Said surprise spike during onboarding blew their pilot budget; finance paused expansion. Intercom convo: https://intercom.fake/conv/12345
Nadia (CS): flagged as renewal risk. Can we scope a quick unblock and a long-term plan?
Ravi (PM): Do we know if they want hard enforcement (reject calls) or alerts only? Also need expected burst patterns.
Marco (CS): quote from them: "we saw a 3x token spike in tests, cost doubled overnight, CFO halted the rollout" — they asked for both quota + webhook so finance can automate alerts.
Tess (Eng): quick reality check: webhook alerting + UI toggle is small work (metric + webhook sender) ~2w. Hard enforcement affects runtime/billing and needs 4-6w + QA. Can do alert alpha behind FF per-account.
Ravi (PM): proposal: 1) ship alert/webhook alpha in 2w behind a feature flag for GreenPillar, 2) scope enforcement for next roadmap sprint if more accounts request.
Lina (Success): I'll confirm with AE and finance if alert-only will unblock the renewal; will prepare a 1-pager for their finance team explaining behaviors and mitigations.
Nadia (CS): if AE says yes, can we get a templated policy note to include in renewal comms?
Ravi (PM): yep — I'll draft a product note + sample webhook payload. Need sanitized sample logs from Marco to tune the 80% threshold so it doesn't spam.
Marco (CS): sending sanitized event history DM now.
product-bot: Created issue RED-5432 "per-account token budget + webhook alerting" linked to epic RED-5400. https://redwood.fake/issue/RED-5432
Tess (Eng): cc infra — we'll need a small metric (per-account token counter) and a retry/backoff delivery for webhooks. If alpha is FFed, rollout risk is low.
Ravi (PM): priority recommendation: P0 for GreenPillar (renewal blocker), P2 for general roadmap until more requests come in.
Lina (Success): adding renewal-risk tag and looping in finance. Also prepping short FAQ + enablement for their billing team.
Nadia (CS): action items: Marco -> sample logs + confirm account acceptance; Lina -> renewal tag + AE confirmation; Ravi -> draft product note + payload; Tess -> feasibility + timeline. I'll update after exec call tomorrow 10am PST. :thumbsup:
